title: 第7章 学神级别的领悟力
slug: 修炼狂潮全本免费-修炼狂潮最新章节列表
content_zh:
在昆仑历时代，每一所学校的教学，都是讲究文武并进，像是公历时代那种只会埋头读书的书呆子，或者只有四肢发达，头脑却简单的莽汉，那都是废物。
昆仑历时代的教学是为了将学生培养成为文武全才，现在的学生，随随便便一个放到公历时代，都是佼佼者。
在还没有进行文武分班之前，一般是按照时间分成上午和下午两个阶段，上午学习各种文科的知识，下午就是修炼武学的时间。
这样才能够培养出文武并进的全才，要知道文武分班之后，才会开始各自有选择性的倾斜。
而一般上文课和武课的时候，又都是在不同的教室当中，文课的教室和公历时代校园的教室差不多，而武课的教室则是一个巨大的比斗场，方便修炼。
楚云凡的到来没有引起任何人的注意，他来到了自己的位置上，从书包中拿出了一个平板电脑。
早在很多年前，就已经淘汰了纸质的书本，统一换成了平板，又方便，又节约环保。
一个平板之中，内置了所有的教材，还有各种习题，还可以随时上网查找资料，是一个非常方便的学习终端。
点开了教材，楚云凡开始看了起来，这是他每天必修的功课，这年头讲究文武并进，就算是考武科班，文课也得有相当的成绩。
不过他很快就发现了不对，他发现，自己点开的教材，几乎能够一目十行，而且过目不忘，看过的地方完全都能够记下来，多回想几遍，原来许多不能理解的地方也都完全能够理解了。
原本他文课的成绩虽然不是很差，但是也没好到哪儿去，只能算是寻常，但是现在他将一门教材全部看完，再做那些对应的练习题的时候，几乎是顺手拈来，看到哪儿就能解到哪儿。
完完全全就是一个学神级别的学习力。
完全超乎了他的想象！
“看来被改造的远远不止是我习武的资质，应该是全方位的改造，就感觉像是我的大脑被开发了！”楚云凡暗自揣摩说道，现在他的思维无比的清晰，许多原本可能想不到的地方，现在也都能够想的到。
这一次的奇遇对他来说，远远不止这么简单，影响深远。
“不管怎么说，这对我来说，都是好事！”
有了这惊人的学习能力，他可以省下多少的时间，而且一个强大的武者，肯定要学习各种东西，远不仅仅只是打坐修炼而已。
有了这种能力，他可以走的更远！
不知不觉，在他的学习之中，时间很快就过去了，到了上第一节课的时候。
第一节课是古篆字的学习，这一门课现如今是各个学校之中的必修课，因为昆仑历时代之中，有太多太多的东西，与超古代文明有关系，而要想更深入的研究，这古篆字是必须了解的。

很快，古篆字课程的老师就进来了，是一个看起来已经六十多岁，发须皆白的老头子，因为看起来年纪相差很大，所以学生们甚至都不叫老师，而是直接叫何老，看起来就像是公历时代中的老学究一样。
但是楚云凡却能敏感的从他的身上感知到有强大的生命波动，显然也是一个武道高手，在那一场梦之后，他的感知也敏锐的多了。
楚云凡暗道，真是人不可貌相，之前两年的时间他都没有发现何老的竟然也是一个强大的武道高手。
众人起身行礼之后，这一堂课就开始了。
一上来，何老就没有多说什么话，而是在电子黑板上，写了一个古篆字。
“这个字我还没有交给你们过，你们都来猜猜，这个字，到底是什么意思！”何老开口说道，虽然外表苍老，不过声音却是中气十足。“作为一个修行之人，学习古篆字是基本的能力，因为许多秘籍原本是直接以古篆字写成的，如果不会古篆字的话，就算你在昆仑界之中得到了什么秘籍也看不懂。
以前我就在课堂上说过，古篆字是象形字，就像是我们华夏的文字一样，所以你们能不能根据这一个古篆字的样子，猜到它本来的意思呢？”
何老看了一眼众人，然后点了其中一个人说道：“冯德英，你来说，你是班长，而且你在古篆字这门课上成绩不错！”
那是一个十六七岁模样的少年，面容俊朗，身材高挑，脸上带着几分倨傲的神情，一看就是家世甚好，深蓝色的武道服，烫着镶金边儿，看着就极为名贵。

content_en:
In the Kunlun Calendar Era, every school's teaching emphasized the advancement of both civility and martial arts. The nerds who only immersed themselves in reading in the Gregorian Calendar Era, or the reckless men who only had well-developed limbs but simple minds, were all useless.
Teaching in the Kunlun Calendar Era was to train students to become all-rounders in both civil and military affairs. Today's students, any one of them in the Gregorian Calendar Era, would be outstanding.
Before the division of civil and military classes, classes were usually divided into morning and afternoon phases according to time. In the morning, students learned various liberal arts knowledge, and in the afternoon, they practiced martial arts.
Only in this way can we cultivate all-round talents who can advance both civil and military classes. We must know that only after the civil and military classes are divided into classes, they will begin to selectively lean towards each other.
Generally, when taking liberal arts classes and martial arts classes, they are in different classrooms. The classrooms for liberal arts classes are similar to those on campus in the Gregorian calendar era, while the classrooms for martial arts classes are a huge fighting arena, which is convenient for practice.
Chu Yunfan's arrival did not attract anyone's attention. He came to his seat and took out a tablet computer from his school bag.
Many years ago, paper books were eliminated and replaced by tablets, which are convenient, environmentally friendly and environmentally friendly.
One tablet has all the teaching materials and various exercises built-in. You can also search for information online at any time. It is a very convenient learning terminal.
Clicking on the textbook, Chu Yunfan began to read it. This was his compulsory homework every day. These days, it is important to advance both civil and military arts. Even if he is taking the martial arts class, he must have a good score in the liberal arts class.
But he soon discovered something was wrong. He found that he could read almost ten lines of the textbook he clicked on, and he had a photographic memory. He could remember everything he had read. After thinking about it a few times, he could completely understand many of the things he couldn't understand.
Although his grades in the liberal arts class were not very bad originally, they were not much better and could only be regarded as ordinary. But now that he has read all the textbooks and does the corresponding exercises, he can easily pick them up and solve them wherever he sees them.
It is completely a god-level learning ability.
It completely exceeded his imagination!
"It seems that what has been transformed is far more than just my martial arts qualifications. It should be an all-round transformation. It feels like my brain has been developed!" Chu Yunfan thought to himself. Now his thinking is extremely clear, and he can now think of many things that he might not have thought of before.
This adventure was far more than simple for him and had a far-reaching impact.
"No matter what, this is a good thing for me!"
With this amazing learning ability, he can save a lot of time, and a powerful warrior must learn all kinds of things, far more than just meditating and practicing.
With this ability, he can go further!
Unknowingly, time passed quickly while he was studying, and it was time for the first class.
The first class is the study of ancient seal characters. This course is now a required course in various schools, because there are too many things in the Kunlun Calendar era that are related to super-ancient civilization. If you want to study more deeply, you must understand these ancient seal characters.
Soon, the teacher of the ancient seal script course came in. He was an old man who looked to be in his sixties, with white hair and beard. Because they seemed to be very different in age, the students didn't even call him teacher, but just called him Lao. He looked like an old scholar in the Gregorian calendar era.
But Chu Yunfan could sensitively sense powerful life fluctuations from his body. He was obviously a martial arts master. After that dream, his perception became much sharper.
Chu Yunfan secretly thought that people really cannot be judged by their appearance. In the past two years, he had not discovered that Mr. He was actually a powerful martial arts master.
After everyone stood up and saluted, the class began.
One upCome on, Mr. He didn't say anything more, but wrote an ancient seal character on the electronic blackboard.
"I haven't given this word to you yet. You all have to guess what this word means!" Mr. He said. Although he looked old, his voice was full of vitality. "As a cultivator, learning ancient seal characters is a basic ability, because many secret books were originally written directly in ancient seal characters. If you don't know ancient seal characters, you will not be able to understand even if you get any secret books in the Kunlun world.
I have said in class before that ancient seal characters are pictographic characters, just like our Chinese characters. So can you guess the original meaning of this ancient seal character based on its appearance? "
Mr. He glanced at everyone, then nodded to one of them and said, "Feng Deying, tell me, you are the squad leader, and you have done well in the ancient seal script class!"
He was a young man of sixteen or seventeen years old, with a handsome face, tall figure, and a somewhat arrogant look on his face. He showed that he came from a good family. His dark blue martial arts uniform was ironed and embellished with gold, and he looked extremely expensive.
